units.source_text: 良清回来，将此情悄悄禀告源氏公子。

en.t: Yoshikiyo returned and quietly reported the matter to Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 公子左思右想，觉得梦境与现实，都是不可思议之事，

en.t: The prince thought it over from every side and felt that both the dream and reality were mysterious things,

units.source_text: 都是显然的神谕。

en.t: and that all of them were clear divine messages.

units.source_text: 他把过去未来之事考虑一番之后，想道：“

en.t: After considering matters of the past and the future, he thought, "

units.source_text: 我倘一味顾虑今后世人的诽议，而辜负神明真心的佑护，

en.t: If I only worry about the criticism people will make hereafter and betray the sincere protection of the gods,

units.source_text: 则世人对我的讥笑，恐将更甚于目前。

en.t: then people's ridicule of me will probably become even worse than it is now.

units.source_text: 辜负现世人的好意，尚且于心不安，何况神意。

en.t: Even betraying the kindness of people in this world leaves the heart uneasy; how much more so the will of the gods.

units.source_text: 我已身受种种悲惨教训，

en.t: I have already suffered all kinds of painful lessons in my own body,

units.source_text: 现在应当听从这个年长位尊、德隆望重之人，遵照他的指示。

en.t: and now I ought to listen to this man of senior years, high rank, great virtue, and deep renown, and follow his directions.

units.source_text: 古人有言：‘退则无咎。’

en.t: The ancients said, 'Withdraw, and there will be no blame.'

units.source_text: 我实在已被逼得濒于死亡，身受了世无其例的苦楚。

en.t: I truly have already been driven to the brink of death and have endured suffering without precedent in the world.

units.source_text: 今后即使不顾身后浮名，也无甚大碍了。

en.t: From now on, even if I pay no heed to the reputation I leave after death, it will do little harm.

units.source_text: 况且梦中亦曾受父皇教谕，命我离去此地。

en.t: Besides, in my dream I also received my imperial father's instruction, commanding me to leave this place.

units.source_text: 我还有什么疑虑呢？”

en.t: What hesitation can I still have?"

units.source_text: 他下决心之后，便命答复明石道人：“

en.t: After he had made up his mind, he ordered this reply to be sent to the Akashi monk: "

units.source_text: 我身飘泊来此异乡，身受莫大苦楚，

en.t: I have drifted here to this strange land and have suffered immense hardship,

units.source_text: 而京都并无一人前来慰问。

en.t: yet not a single person has come from the capital to ask after me.

units.source_text: 惟有仰望缥缈行空的日月光华，视为故乡之亲友。

en.t: I have only looked up at the light of the sun and moon drifting through the distant sky and regarded it as my family and friends from home.

units.source_text: 今天想不到‘好风吹送钓舟来’。

en.t: Today, unexpectedly, 'a favorable wind has blown a fishing boat to me.'

units.source_text: 你那明石浦上可有容我隐遁之处？”

en.t: Is there a place on your Akashi shore where I might live in seclusion?"

units.source_text: 明石道人欢喜无限，感激不尽。

en.t: The Akashi monk was boundlessly delighted and endlessly grateful.
